name: Sedona
about: Spring (Mar–Apr) and fall (Oct) bring the best hiking weather and the biggest crowds; summer regularly tops 100°F, best endured at dawn or dusk.
overview: Red rock formations, a wellness scene built around 'energy vortex' sites, and the Southwest's best hiking and biking under desert skies.
costOverview: Basic food and trailhead parking are reasonable — Jeep tours and the town's wellness/spa scene are where the real spending happens.
monthlyWeather: cool and dry, pleasant days with cold desert nights
